notes:
Pages are read in the right order.

On webtoons and manhwa the reader could speak a balloon, move down a panel, then walk back up the page to read another one. On Infinite Gacha chapter 1 that was happening to 15 lines out of 116, one of them several panels back up the page. All four test titles now read top to bottom with nothing out of order.

Status windows are read again. Stat blocks were being dropped as if they were recogniser noise — in a genre built on numbers, that quietly removed part of the chapter. They are spoken now, and so are lines like "[Skill] [Stealth] acquired!".

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
